title: Move knowledge of registering protocols to the application layer
description: For future flexibility, have the application provide the callbacks to handling register "protocols" and their handoff functions. Then epan_init() just provides those callbacks to proto_init() as part of the general initialization of the dissection engine.

 typedef enum {

 #define RA_BASE_COUNT (RA_INTERFACES - 3) // RA_EXTCAP, RA_LUA_PLUGINS, RA_LUA_DEREGISTER
 
 typedef void (*register_cb)(register_action_e action, const char *message, void *client_data);

commits_data.title: Move knowledge of registering protocols to the application layer
commits_data.message:
Move knowledge of registering protocols to the application layer

For future flexibility, have the application provide the callbacks to handling register "protocols" and their handoff functions. Then epan_init() just provides those callbacks to proto_init() as part of the general initialization of the dissection engine.
